title: acanthospermum humile var. hispidum
intro: Acanthospermum humile var. hispidum, commonly known as the hairy stickseed, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Acanthospermum humile var. hispidum include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
